builder.cli: python build_block.py --width W --height H --kind ground|deck|pier --left solid|broken --right solid|broken --output ABSOLUTE_PATH
builder.output: RGBA PNG exactly W x H; native pixels; no scaling; top row opaque across W

structure.ground: 12 px road deck + 2 px under-eave shadow + 20 px-ish bearing courses + 10 px base; high=6 courses, 64 px bank=2
structure.deck: continuous stone beam; 6–24 px tall; top strip 2–3 px, lit face, darker lower beam body, 2–3 px soffit; not a squashed 15 px road
structure.pier: vertical support; 3 px cap + drum stack + 6 px base; 8 px modules for W=8; wider piers use continuous same-palette sides in builder
structure.break: top strip always full width; only below the strip retreats 1–4 px (ground 1–4, deck 1–2, pier 1); no interior holes, no fake steps. Atlas 24x40 cores serve ground; deck/pier fractures are builder-drawn from the same palette to fit their height range without stretching.

shadow_model.road: TOP/TOPHI top, LIGHT/LIGHT2 face; bright but not white
shadow_model.eave: 2 px explicit DEEP+DARK band under the deck
shadow_model.bearing: discrete course tones MID2 -> MID -> MIDD -> BEAR -> BEAR2, with local LIGHT/LIT stones
shadow_model.break: MID2/MID/MIDD/BEAR core chunks, DEEP inner crack, 1–2 LIGHT catches; no uniform dark strip
shadow_model.rule: no linear transparent black overlay and no global modulate; all shadows are painted stone/joint/underside pixels
